kit.caption: Caption or note
kit.description: Turns a folder of maps, tokens and handouts into a one-shot the table can use: named, gridded or gridless, fitted, framed, and handed to Foundry or Roll20 the way each wants it.
kit.empty: Nothing in this kit yet. Add pictures with the button above, choosing whether they are maps, tokens or handouts, or drop a folder of maps into the kit's maps folder and press Refresh.
kit.error.nameclash: There is already a {0} in that folder.
kit.export.foundry.hint: A folder with every picture and a kit.json the meows-kit module reads: one scene per map, gridded or not, in this order, in a folder named after the kit.
kit.export.roll20.hint: Roll20 has no way in, so this is the files spelled its way: maps sized to whole 70 px units so the grid lines up on upload, numbered in order, under the limit, and a ROLL20.md saying which page gets which.
kit.fit.hint: Down to that longest side, as WebP, or PNG if it has transparency. The grid number scales with it. The original stays under originals.
kit.frame.hint: A border outside the picture, never over it: the canvas grows and the grid stays where it was.
kit.grid.enabled.hint: Untick it for a map played without one. The VTT then gets a gridless scene and the size is in pixels, which is a choice rather than a missing number.
kit.grid.none.long: Gridless. The scene is measured in pixels.
kit.grid.squares.long: {0} × {1} squares, {2} px each. Check the blue lines sit on the map's own lines.
kit.name: Name, as the VTT shows it
kit.status.exported.foundry: {0} files written to {1}. Upload that folder through Foundry's file picker and press Import a kit in the meows-kit module.
kit.status.exported.roll20: {0} files written to {1}. ROLL20.md in there says what to do with each.
kit.status.fitted: {0} fitted: {1} to {2}. The original is under originals.
kit.status.framed: {0} framed with {1}, {2} px added on every side; the grid did not move.
kit.status.start: Pick a kit on the left, or make one.
kit.status.token: {0} cut round with {1}. The original is under originals.
kit.title: Kits
kit.token.hint: The picture inside the ring, the ring on top, and nothing outside the ring. 512 × 512 PNG, which is what a VTT wants a token to be. The original stays under originals.
